name: TCL Technology Group Corporation
summary: TCL Technology Group Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the advanced manufacturing industry in Mainland China and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Semiconductor Display Business; New Energy Photovoltaic and Other Silicon Materials Business; Distribution Business; and Other Businesses. The Semiconductor Display Business segment is involved in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of semiconductor display panels, semiconductor display modules, and display machine processing.
